app.title: Timbre Weave
app.subtitle: Assign MIDI notes to a chosen ensemble by playability
ui.theme.label: Theme
ui.theme.hint: Switch between dark and light theme
ui.midi.title: Source MIDI
ui.midi.subtitle: Pick a source file and tick the tracks to distribute
ui.ensemble.title: Ensemble
ui.ensemble.subtitle: Pick the instruments to distribute onto (max {})
ui.ensemble.add_hint: Add one instance (the same instrument can be added multiple times, e.g. two violins)
ui.ensemble.empty: No instrument yet — hit + in the pool above
ui.ensemble.full: Limit of {} reached, remove one first
ui.report.title: Run & Report
ui.report.subtitle: Per-instrument note counts appear here after a run
ui.report.pool_size_hint: A larger pool approaches exhaustive search (closer to the global optimum) at the cost of speed
ui.report.shared_channels_warning: {} instruments share channels (more than 15 instruments; MIDI only has 15 usable channels): they overwrite each other's GM program on one port — export in two batches instead
ui.report.pool_saturated_warning: {} onset groups filled the candidate pool (pruning happened); raise the pool size for more accuracy
ui.report.dropped_warning: {} notes were dropped, check the ensemble or range settings
ui.report.forced_warning: {} notes were forced onto instruments that cannot play them: the instruments that could were already taken in that group. Add instruments or widen ranges
msg.split_empty: Error: no usable notes in the selected tracks
msg.no_file_selected: Error: select a MIDI file first
msg.no_track_selected: Error: tick at least one source track first
msg.no_instrument_selected: Error: pick at least one instrument first
log.i18n_save_failed: Warning: failed to save language setting - {}
log.theme_save_failed: Warning: failed to save theme setting - {}
log.split.start: Split started: {} source tracks, {} notes, {} instruments
log.split.stats: Split done: {} onset groups, {} notes written; {} octave folds, {} octave merges, {} drops
log.split.doubling: Onset groups with doubling: {} ({} doubled notes in total)
log.split.overflow: Warning: onset groups with too many simultaneous notes were truncated by velocity (see drop count)
log.split.pool_saturated: Warning: {} onset groups filled the candidate pool (size {}), the result is not guaranteed globally optimal
log.split.shared_channels: Warning: instruments share channels ({}): they overwrite each other's GM program on one MIDI port
log.split.forced_notes: Warning: {} notes were forced onto out-of-range instruments (the ones that could play them were already taken in that group)
log.split.unassignable_group: Warning: an onset group could not be assigned at all and was dropped by velocity (should not happen)
